messages:
DeployBot: PROD deploy started for tag v4.0.0-rc3 (commit ab12cd3). env=prod-us-west-2. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. canary=10% -> will ramp to 100% unless checks fail. release notes: https://go/release-notes/v4.0.0-rc3 :rocket:

alex-rl: ack. I'm on standby for rollout. running quick smoke suite now (curl smoke endpoint + lint checks). will post results shortly.

marta-oncall: watching metrics and errors dashboard <https://go/observability/prod-usw2|prod-usw2 dash>. FYI DB team confirmed no blocking migration in this rollout, just a soft index update behind a flag.

jamal-infra: feature flag gating is enabled for the new embeddings path. if we see latency > 250ms P95, we should flip the flag and pin to previous tag. rollback plan: `rdeploy rollback --to v3.9.8 --env prod-us-west-2`

sophie-eng: smoke tests green (all endpoints 200). sample command used: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'`

DeployBot: Canary ramp to 10% complete. initial telemetry: token p95 168ms, error rate 0.02% (baseline 0.03%). no anomaly detected in canary.

alex-rl: proceeding with gradual traffic shift. moving to 50% now. monitoring latency, mem, and kv-cache hit rate. tagging ops with :eyes:.

DeployBot: Traffic shift to 50% complete. health checks passing.

marta-oncall: seeing a small spike in tail latency on a small subset (~0.5% of hosts) — bump to 300ms P99 for those. jamal can you check kernel/kernel patch scheduling on those hosts?

jamal-infra: looking. found one host with GPU driver hickup, restarting runtime on host i-0a1b2c3d. will keep traffic off until ready.

DeployBot: Pause traffic shift (automated safeguard triggered) — one or more hosts degraded. holding at 50%. not progressing until manual resume.

alex-rl: good catch. hold for 5m while jamal fixes. if issues persist, we'll flip embedding flag and pin to v3.9.8.

jamal-infra: runtime restarted, GPU back to healthy. forcing drain/rejoin, rebalancing traffic.

DeployBot: Resume traffic shift. progressing 50% -> 100% over next 8 minutes.

DeployBot: PROD deploy complete for tag v4.0.0-rc3 (commit ab12cd3). final checks: all services green, error rate below baseline, P95 latency stable. rollout duration 18m. release notes: https://go/release-notes/v4.0.0-rc3. :tada:

ci-cd-bot: Tag v4.0.0-rc3 pinned to prod (immutable) for rollback window 2h. Audit log: https://go/audit/3087654321

alex-rl: closing change window early. will leave monitoring hooks for next 2h and keep the rollback plan ready. thanks everyone — great coordination. :shipit:

marta-oncall: marking as monitored. if anything crops up I'll open an incident channel. otherwise closing thread in 2h.
